name: mock-browser-window
title: Mock Browser Window
description: A rounded mock app window with three macOS dots, a URL bar and a left sidebar, holding a demo dashboard of three stat cards and a bar chart. It is a frame; the sidebar and content come from props and children.
use: You want to frame a dashboard screenshot as a believable app window on a marketing page.
avoid: Real navigation is needed: this is a static frame whose dots and links do nothing.
a11y: Traffic dots and sidebar rows look clickable but are plain divs with no handlers or keyboard access. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded window with a thin border. The top row has three small traffic-light dots on the left and a pill-shaped URL bar in the centre. A narrow left sidebar lists five items, the first tinted as active, beside three small stat cards and a row of grey bars.
behaves: Static: nothing moves or responds. The URL, sidebar items and inner content are supplied by props and children, but the frame itself has no interaction.
customise: size, variant, headerStyle, url, showSidebar, sidebarPosition, sidebarItems and theme are props; the window content is children. The theme prop currently has no effect.
weight: light: A few nested divs and one inline SVG; no images, scripts or motion.

props.name: sidebarItems
props.type: Array<{ icon?: React.ReactNode; label: string; active?: boolean; badge?: string | number }>
